这个实验室解释光学原理，不代表个人的眼睛，也不代表任何具体人工晶状体。临床选择仍: This laboratory explains optical principles. It does not represent an individual eye or a specific IOL. Clinical decisions require an eye examination and the exact lens model.
采用标量、近轴 Fourier optics（傅里叶光学）。波长固定为 550: Scalar, paraxial Fourier optics at a fixed 550 nm wavelength, with an adjustable circular pupil. The Fourier transform of the pupil phase yields a PSF whose total energy is normalized. MTF describes optical contrast transfer across spatial frequencies, not human contrast sensitivity.
波前包括离焦、规则散光与选定的球差项。球差在 6 mm 瞳孔下设为 0.20 μ: The wavefront includes defocus, regular astigmatism and a chosen spherical-aberration term. Spherical aberration is set to 0.20 μm at a 6 mm pupil and scales with the fourth power of pupil diameter. This is a teaching assumption, not a corneal measurement. Ideal Aspheric compensation can cancel that term. The offset slider displaces the correction in the equivalent pupil plane; it cannot be translated into real IOL decentration.
理想眼镜仅抵消散光，不添加阅读度数。对准轴位且度数匹配的理想 Toric（散光型: Ideal glasses cancel cylinder only, without a reading addition. An aligned, power-matched ideal Toric correction also cancels regular astigmatism. Rotating a matched cylinder C by angle θ leaves residual cylinder 2C|sin θ|. Rotation is an optical scenario, not a probability.
照片为 Petaling Jaya（八打灵再也）风格的 AI 生成街景，不是某一: The photos are AI-generated streets inspired by Petaling Jaya, not records of an identified street. Their existing imaging artifacts remain. Images are converted to linear light, convolved with the PSF, then converted back to display colour. This independent laboratory uses an assumed 8° horizontal field and a 129 × 129 convolution kernel, reporting its retained energy. Edge extension avoids artificial black borders.
PSF 图为中央裁剪，并用固定对数尺度放大显示弱光结构；不能把图上亮度或大小当作: PSF plots use a central crop and a fixed logarithmic scale to reveal faint structure. Displayed brightness and size are not perceived halo severity. The reading text is synthetic, not a standardized eye chart.
未模拟完整的多色人眼、白内障散射、视网膜疾病、神经适应、双眼融合或真实人工晶状体: The model omits the complete polychromatic eye, cataract scatter, retinal disease, neuroadaptation, binocular fusion and complex real IOL designs. The main app uses a simplified three-focus PSF mixture and a separate visual halo/haze control, not a real product model. This independent laboratory handles single-focus optics only.
数值检查包括 FFT 正反变换、能量守恒、理想 MTF 与解析衍射极限、散光及球: Numerical checks cover FFT inversion, energy conservation, comparison with the analytical diffraction limit, ideal cylinder and spherical-aberration cancellation, and linear-light convolution. Numerical correctness is not clinical validation. The app has not been reviewed by an ophthalmologist.
